SYSTEM_locked.name: final 6v6 Separated system (STANDARDIZED_6V6_SPLIT_K1_CONFIRMATORY)
SYSTEM_locked.pole_A_policy: split composite: split k1 pi_D on DEFEND + c2 pi_A frozen on ATTACK, roles fixed for the episode, CLOSEST_DEFENDS k=1

CONDITIONS_locked.tier_source: values are read at run time from DEPLOYMENT_ROBUSTNESS_SPEC.json#TIERS (eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.resolve_perturbation), which also requires DEPLOYMENT_ONLY_GUARANTEE_CHECK.json PASS

MECHANISMS_locked.localization_noise: core.rt_sensor_noise_sigma_cells = sigma after reset (grid/vec observation model) AND independent N(0, sigma^2) on every entity dx/dy with dist recomputed (entity tensors are built from true positions, so the core noise alone would leave them exact) AND the CLOSEST_DEFENDS allocator ranks agents by noisy own-position estimates (PI 2026-09-28). The first grid/vec observation after reset precedes the core setting, as in the precedent evaluator; the first entity observation and the one role assignment are already noisy.
MECHANISMS_locked.motion_error: core.rt_drift_sigma_cells = sigma after reset (Gaussian noise on post-motion position)
MECHANISMS_locked.control_delay: rl.control_delay.DelayBuffer(ticks) on the final executed action (after the ATTACK/DEFEND splice), fresh per episode
MECHANISMS_locked.determinism: every noise stream is seeded by the episode seed; a crash + --resume reproduces the uninterrupted rows (tests/test_eval_crossover_perturbation.py)
MECHANISMS_locked.deployment_only: no training code reads any of these; the students/teachers are frozen checkpoints

SEEDS.why_one_block: degradation is read paired within seed against the nominal run (precedent ROBUSTNESS_2V2_RUNG1_RESULT)

READINGS.per_condition: Delta_A = V(pi_A+D, A) - V(pi_B, A); Delta_B = V(pi_B, B) - V(pi_A+D, B); mean with 95% CI
READINGS.paired_degradation: for each condition: its per-seed Delta minus the nominal run's per-seed Delta on the same seed, and the same for each policy's win rate on its own pole; eval_hog_psp_v3._mean_ci
READINGS.headline: mean effects (PI reporting rule 2026-09-27); the nominal run here is the noise reference only -- the 6v6 main value is STANDARDIZED_6V6_SPLIT_K1_CONFIRMATORY
READINGS.caption_caveat: For localization and motion perturbations, we use a matched numeric severity schedule of 0.03, 0.06, and 0.12 cells to enable controlled comparison across perturbation families. These levels are not assumed to represent equivalent behavioral difficulty.
